messages:
Lina: starting the quarterly recurrence patterns synthesis. I've pulled the raw incident set for Q1. we should prioritize 3 themes: scheduler flapping, model-variant regressions, and eviction cascades. goal: owners + short remediation plans + measurable success criteria.

Devon: Agree. Can we surface frequency, customer impact score, and time-to-recovery (median) per theme? That will help prioritize.

Rakesh: Quick numbers from my export: total recurring incidents (Q1)=14. scheduler: 6, model-switch: 5, eviction: 3. median ttr: scheduler=18m, model-switch=42m, eviction=26m. I'll drop CSV to the recurrence board.

Emilie: For model-variant regressions the common thread is incompatible tokenizers when we swap to smaller quantized builds. Short-term: add preflight tokenization check in rollout pipeline. Long-term: gate model swaps with automated evals. Owner: Emilie. ETA: preflight check in 2w, gated eval tooling 10w.

Ken: Scheduler flapping root cause: miscalibrated cool-down + missed heartbeat on spot reclaim. Short-term mitigation: extend scheduler debounce and add conservative reclaim window for hot pools. Long-term: heartbeat redundancy + improved metrics. Owner: Ken. ETA: short-term 1w, long-term 12w.

svc-monitor: alert: created #INC-2026-1145 "Scheduler flapping affecting warm pools" linked to thread

Lina: Nice. For each remediation we need: rollout plan, rollback trigger, and success metric (e.g., 95th latency percentiles, recurrence count drop). Put those in one-line action items so the board can consume them.

Rakesh: action items (one-line):
- "Ken | extend scheduler debounce + conservative reclaim window | 2026-04-01"
- "Emilie | add tokenizer preflight to model swap pipeline | 2026-04-08"
- "Devon | create eviction-monitoring dashboard + low-threshold alert | 2026-03-29"

Devon: I'll also add a spike-test job that replays production traffic for 30m to validate scheduler changes before canary. Rollout: dev -> canary (10%) -> region -> global.

Emilie: Preflight check will run tokenization sample across the target binary. If mismatch >0.1% tokens flagged, block swap. Rollback trigger: swap causes >2x increase in 5xx within 30m.

Ken: Debounce change is small config toggle. Canary plan: apply to one warm pool for 24h, monitor pod churn and request errors. Rollback if pod churn doesn't decrease or latency increases >10%.

Lina: Also want to capture a simple mitigation playbook for oncall: when scheduler flapping observed -> 1) disable spot reclaim for affected pool 2) drain noncritical jobs 3) scale warm pool manually. Keep it short.

Devon: Playbook snippet for model regressions:
- pause model rollout
- revert to previous model variant
- run tokenization dry-run on candidate model binary
- escalate to model-onboarding if failing

Rakesh: I ran the following to assemble incidents:
```
incidents export --labels recurring --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-03-31 --format csv > q1_recurring.csv
```
Lina: Good. Next: owners confirm in-thread (reply with :white_check_mark:), Jordan from reliability will audit overlapping ownerships. We'll host a follow-up in 7 days to verify dashboards and initial canaries.

Ken: Confirming ownership for scheduler changes :white_check_mark:. I'll post canary timeline in infra tickets.

Emilie: Confirming ownership for model preflight :white_check_mark:. Will add pipeline job and tests.

Devon: Confirming dashboard + spike-test :white_check_mark:. ETA as above.

Rakesh: I'll attach CSV and coarse heatmap to the recurrence board. Also adding notes about customer-facing incidents so support can notify impacted accounts.

Lina: Great. Summary of immediate success criteria: reduce recurrence count for scheduler by 50% within 6 weeks; model-swap regressions reduced to 0 repeats after gating; eviction cascades flagged by new alert within 2w. We'll track weekly. Closing thread, will post the action table to the recurrence board. :rocket:
